source: Client proves join gate level<=45, clan99, mark49, no master; server graduation scheduling and retention are project rules.
join: Enabled trusted owner, persistent level1..45, no other or pending membership, not previously graduated; repeat refuses.
leave: Authenticated own training membership; -20 manual or ordinary C1036; -60 requires persisted level>45 or existing graduation. Duplicate C1036 following C1108 does not perform a second transition.
graduation: Persistent level>45 reconciled by the bound main connection at most once per10 seconds (first poll immediate), or by an authenticated training exit. Persist graduation and removal atomically; S1515 once per game connection, S1037 and canonical S1016 to the current clan binding. Profile reads recover persisted notices without performing graduation.
cooldown: 60 seconds after a training membership change before another join (client cooldown observed, server enforcement is project policy).
identity: Reserve clan99 on first join, canonical Korean training label and mark49; ordinary directory hides99; no officers/applicants/points/recruitment management in99.
recovery: Durable training history preserves pending -20/-60 exit until next membership assignment; main graduation notification once per game connection. Ordinary membership always dominates historic removal.
scope: Training membership is usable independently; clan channel80/matches remain separate subsequent work.
roster: Training C1011/C1013/C1069 resynchronize S1016, with no global trainee enumeration; native training UI bypasses these ordinary roster queries.
baselines: Capacity65535, level1, points0, recruitment2, epoch birth date and introduction equal to training label are explicit project baselines, not recovered original server defaults.
